scope: P1 map relationalization and P2 single-producer page demand; hand-coded JDBC fixture, not production binding
isolation: SERIALIZABLE read-only; common snapshot across arms in a case; no writers between timing and diagnostics
timing_includes: complete typed row consumption and JSON rendering
timing_excludes: source analysis and production live binding, which are not implemented here

diagnostics.transport: actual PostgreSQL stream bytes in both directions, through counting TCP proxy only in separate untimed pass; excludes connection setup and TLS; admin HTTP is a different socket
diagnostics.memory: JVM heap-pool peak sum after reset, heap before/after and peak-minus-before upper bound; not process RSS or a simultaneous heap high-water mark
diagnostics.plans: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) for actual captured SQL/parameters; separate from timing and network measurements
diagnostics.logical_input: effective association rows for full target domain and demanded page

data.effective_link_rows: exact requested rows per visible target; duplicate document references allowed
data.noise: per target: one unauthorized link, one deleted link, one other-tenant link
data.targets: unique ordered row_id and key; nullable labels; insertion order randomized by seed
data.prior_semantic_scope: duplicate target occurrences, empty cases and consumer rejection covered by archived smoke tests

stop: One fixed run; no new scales, indexes or parameter tuning based on results. Preserve failed attempts if operational fixes are required.
interpretation: Single local process/container, warm timing blocks, three data seeds; not independent deployment replications or a production speedup claim
